llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent for calculating reorder points and recommended quantities. It does not request credentials, install code, or make external calls. Before using, verify the numeric assumptions (demand, lead time, variability, MOQ) you provide and cross-check outputs against your ERP or purchasing rules — the skill produces guidance, not an authoritative system integration. If you plan to integrate these calculations into automated ordering, implement appropriate safeguards (rate limits, approval steps, and validation) before any automated spend or order placement.
